__: The version of each PRODUCT in this repository, and the only place it is decided. Every other spelling -- each plugin's build (cmake/NiJucePlugin.cmake), the bundles' Info.plist and moduleinfo.json, module.json and each engine's crates -- is DERIVED from this and checked by `ctest -R versions`. The scheme is v<YYYY.MM.DD>.<subversion>; three of those consumers cannot hold that string literally, so the derivations are spelled out in tests/versions.test.mjs and asserted rather than left to a human. See tests/versions.test.mjs for what is checked and what is deliberately not.
__audio-bus: The house transport, not a plugin -- it has crates and no bundle. It is versioned here anyway because it is a thing that SHIPS INSIDE two products, and a crate whose version nothing checks is a crate that will disagree with itself.
__ground: The animated ground's beat clock. Not a plugin either, and not even a library of its own on disk: ground-capi is an rlib that each product's capi crate absorbs, because one static archive per plugin is an invariant here (see cmake/NiRust.cmake). It is versioned for audio-bus's reason and one more -- it ships inside every product that animates the ground, so a crate that disagreed with itself would disagree in each of them at once.
__music-core: Music theory: pitches, chords, keys and modes. Not a plugin either -- a shared crate that NI Chord-Detector names chords with and that neo-riemann (codeberg.org/graebe/neo-riemann) builds on through a git dependency on this repository. Versioned here because a crate another repository pins by revision should say which release it is.
